description: This file contains utility functions for calculator operation codes, including range checks for different categories of operations such as binary, unary, digit, and GUI setting commands.

methods.name: IsOpInRange
methods.description: Checks if an operation code falls within a specified range.

methods.name: IsBinOpCode
methods.description: Determines if an operation code is a binary operation.

methods.name: IsUnaryOpCode
methods.description: Determines if an operation code is a unary operation.

methods.name: IsDigitOpCode
methods.description: Checks if an operation code is a digit.

methods.name: IsGuiSettingOpCode
methods.description: Checks if an operation code corresponds to a GUI setting command.
